name: Sugiura
source:
"I'm Sugiura, an associate professor at Sagami University. I'm still learning a lot from Director Yamamura. I hope we get the chance to meet at the hospital someday."

An associate professor working at Yamamura University Hospital. He's quite handsome and popular with the students. He doesn't let it go to his head, however.

He's diligent and passionate about his work. Being a good guy sometimes feels like a death flag, doesn't it? I hope he's okay.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category7&ch=sugiura]official website[/url]]
